parameters.content:
## Shopify product images

Finds each tagged product's page on the manufacturer's own site, scrapes its gallery, ranks the photos by real pixel size, checks the best ones with a vision model (which also writes the alt text) and sends one Slack card per product. Approved photos are padded to white 2048 x 2048 squares and added to Shopify with readable file names.

### How it works
1. **Setup** (run once) creates `image_queue`, `image_log`, `brand_domains` and `alt_queue` and seeds your brand websites.
2. **Find** (hourly) picks up to 10 products tagged `needs-images`, finds the manufacturer page (metafield, URL pattern, or a DataForSEO search), ranks and checks the images and posts a card with a numbered contact sheet.
3. **Review** (Slack buttons) checks Slack's signature and saves your ticks. Approve starts Publish.
4. **Publish** pads, names and adds the images, waits until Shopify says `READY`, moves the main image first, detaches the old one if you unticked it and replies in the thread. It also builds the contact sheets.
5. **Alt text** (weekly) rewrites empty, title-copy, file-name and repeated alt text after you approve the digest.

### Setup
1. Credentials: Custom Auth (Shopify client ID and secret) on the four **Get Shopify token** nodes, Slack API on the Slack nodes, Crypto (signing secret) on **Sign the request**, Ollama on both chat models, Basic Auth on **Search Google** if you use DataForSEO.
2. Fill in the four settings nodes and the brands in **Setup settings**, then run **Run once to set up**.
3. Point your Slack app's Interactivity URL at **Slack button click** and publish.
4. Keep `dry_run` on in **Publish settings** until the first report looks right.

### Customisation
Swap either **Ollama Chat Model** for any vision-capable chat model. Add brands and URL patterns to `brand_domains`.

## Setup
Run once. Creates the four data tables (running it again keeps them) and adds the brand websites from **Setup settings** to `brand_domains`.

messageValues.message:
You check product photos for an online store and write their alt text. Look only at the photo you are given. Reply with a JSON object with exactly these keys: white_background, single_product, packaging, lifestyle, added_text and matches (each true or false), view (a string) and alt_text (a string).

white_background: a plain white or very light, empty background.
single_product: the product itself is the main subject.
packaging: a retail box or packaging is visible.
lifestyle: shown in a room, on a building, outdoors or in use.
added_text: text, logos or watermarks laid over the photo after it was taken. Ignore printing, logos and labels on the product itself.
matches: it plausibly shows the product named in the message.
view: one of front, side, back, top, detail, in the box, in use, accessories.
alt_text: one sentence under 125 characters that says what this shot shows: the angle, the colour, and what is attached or included. Name the product once. Don't start with "Image of" or "Picture of". No keyword lists, prices or marketing words.

nodes.notes: One call per image: the checks and the alt text together. On error it carries on, so every image still lines up with its answer.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat Model
nodes.notes: Ollama Cloud: Base URL https://ollama.com and your API key. Any vision-capable chat model works.

nodes.name: Score and write alt
nodes.notes: Moves each score by the vision answers, unticks overlaid text or the wrong product, and gives every image its own alt text.

## Publish
Runs after an Approve, and hourly as a backstop. One approved product per run: pad each photo to a white square, name it after the product, add it with its alt text, wait for Shopify to say READY, then set the main image and detach the old one. `dry_run` writes a report instead.

nodes.notes: Scales the photo to fit inside the square: shrink if larger, then enlarge if smaller. (Maximum Area caps the pixel count, not the sides.) PNG keeps any transparent background.

## Alt text
Weekly. Finds images whose alt text is empty, copies the title, looks like a file name or repeats on the product, asks the vision model for a new one, checks it and posts a digest. Approve all applies it with `fileUpdate`; `auto_apply` skips the digest.

messageValues.message:
You write alt text for product photos in an online store. Reply with a JSON object with two keys: view (one of front, side, back, top, detail, in the box, in use, accessories) and alt_text (a string).

alt_text: one sentence under 125 characters that says what this shot shows: the angle, the colour, and what is attached or included. Name the product once. Don't start with "Image of" or "Picture of". No keyword lists, prices or marketing words. If the photo doesn't show the product named in the message, set alt_text to an empty string.
